card.statement:
Suppose that either:

(i)

$\mathfrak{g}=\mathfrak{so}_{n}$ and all parts of the partition are odd; or

(ii)

$\mathfrak{g}=\mathfrak{sp}_{n}$ and all parts of the partition are even.

Then the Poisson structure on the Slodowy slice is isomorphic to a truncation of the shifted twisted Yangian for $\mathfrak{o}_{n}$ .

One of the key tools in the proofs of [BK06] are the parabolic presentations of shifted Yangians. These interpolate between the RTT presentation and the Drinfeld presentation. The former should be thought of as analogous to presenting a simple Lie algebra via a Chevalley $\mathbb{Z}$ -form, whilst the latter is akin to the Chevalley–Serre presentation. For future developments it is important to discover parabolic presentations of twisted Yangians $\mathcal{Y}_{n}$ and their shifted analogues (see [LWZ23, §1.3]). Our second main theorem provides these presentations at the semiclassical level. We state the result informally now, and provide a more detailed statement and proof in Remark 5.11.
card.label: Corollary 1

paper.title: Shifted twisted Yangians and Slodowy slices in classical Lie algebras
paper.abstract: In this paper we introduce the shifted twisted Yangian of type {\sf AI}, following the work of Lu--Wang--Zhang, and we study their semiclassical limits, a class of Poisson algebras. We demonstrate that they coincide with the Dirac reductions of the semiclassical shifted Yangian for $\mathfrak{gl}_n$. We deduce that these shifted twisted Yangians admit truncations which are isomorphic to Slodowy slices for many non-rectangular nilpotent elements in types {\sf B}, {\sf C}, {\sf D}. As a direct consequence we obtain parabolic presentations of the semiclassical shifted twisted Yangian, analogous to those introduced by Brundan--Kleshchev for the Yangian of type {\sf A}. Finally we give Poisson presentations of Slodowy slices for all even nilpotent elements in types {\sf B}, {\sf C}, {\sf D}, generalising the recent work of the second author.
